patterns.note: Content sections frequently use an asymmetrical two-column layout, pairing large, bold numbers or high-contrast black and white photography with descriptive text.
The site employs a high-contrast monochromatic palette of black, white, and light grey, punctuated by a single deep purple accent color for interactive elements like buttons and links.
Headings are set in a large, bold sans-serif, providing strong visual hierarchy against lighter, more readable body text, maintaining a clean and modern aesthetic.
The hero section features a subtle parallax effect where the background image scrolls slower than the foreground content, creating depth as the user scrolls down the page.
Sections are clearly delineated by generous vertical whitespace and alternating background colors (white and a very light grey), enhancing readability and visual breathing room.

technique_notes: The hero section implements a parallax scroll effect by having the background image move at a slower rate than the page scroll, while the overlaying text remains fixed relative to the viewport until the section fully scrolls out.
The main navigation bar is built to stick to the top of the viewport after the initial scroll, ensuring persistent access to key navigation links and the contact call-to-action.
Content sections are introduced with subtle fade-in or slide-up animations as they enter the viewport, providing a smooth and engaging reveal experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~2.5-3x body) provide strong visual anchors, complemented by a clean, readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are dominant across most elements, with only a very subtle rounding applied to interactive elements like buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy density with generous vertical spacing between sections and within content blocks, creating a sense of openness and clarity.

standout: The site's distinctive use of high-contrast black and white photography, often with a subtle, deep purple accent, creates a sophisticated and editorial feel. This, combined with a minimalist layout and ample whitespace, elevates the brand beyond a typical corporate site, making the imagery itself a core part of the design language.
